item.title: Version 17.0.0
item.description:
About v17.0.0 Update

  • 📅 Release date
    • Nov 27, 2026
  • 🔔 Important Notes
    • After upgrading, enable Karabiner-Elements Privileged Daemons v3 under Background App Activity in System Settings.
    • When upgrading, a one-time Karabiner-Updater.app can't be opened error may appear after the update. This error can be safely ignored.
  • 💥 Breaking Changes
    • Moved karabiner_cli from /Library/Application Support/org.pqrs/Karabiner-Elements/bin/karabiner_cli to /Applications/Karabiner-Elements.app/Contents/Helpers/karabiner_cli.
    • Moved bundled helper apps into /Applications/Karabiner-Elements.app/Contents/Helpers.
    • Moved maintenance scripts into /Applications/Karabiner-Elements.app/Contents/Resources.
  • 🔒 Security
    • Fixed a race in configuration file ownership checks. On Karabiner-Elements 16.3.0 and earlier, a local attacker on a Mac with multiple user accounts could infer limited information about another user's configuration, such as custom key mappings. Security advisory GHSA-3xf6-mj44-3q6g
    • Fixed a race in local IPC authentication. On Karabiner-Elements 16.0.0 through 16.3.0, malware already running on the Mac could obtain focused UI element titles and, where collected, focused window titles if Karabiner-Elements had Accessibility permission. Security advisory GHSA-rj4j-2pp3-m4ww
  • ✨ New Features
    • Added Japanese localization.
    • Add Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) translations (Thanks to @maodun96 and @msuadOf)
    • Added mouse_motion_and_wheel_to_key (Thanks to @BenjaminVanRyseghem)
    • Added set_caps_lock_led to complex modifications, which allows the caps lock LED to be turned on or off independently of the caps lock state. (Thanks to @anandghegde)
    • Added support for remapping buttons on supported Logitech HID++ devices. (Thanks to @robertn702)
    • Added "Shift + keys" category to Simple Modifications. (Thanks to @sadoiadosoias)
    • Added system.ui_language to variables.
    • Added settings to the Expert tab for including device_address, location_id, serial_number, and transport in device identifiers, allowing devices with the same vendor ID and product ID to be configured separately.
    • Added serial_number and transport support to device conditions. device_address conditions now use the physical device property regardless of the device identifier settings.
    • Added Accessibility monitoring settings to the Expert tab, allowing monitoring of the frontmost application, focused window, and focused UI element to be enabled or disabled independently.
  • 🐛 Bug Fixes
    • Fixed an issue where a notification window could remain visible when the number of available screens decreased. (Thanks to @zoo3323)
    • Fixed an issue where Caps Lock events generated by key remapping were remapped again when CGEventTap fallback was enabled.
    • Fixed an issue where ISO layout-specific keys (e.g., `~ / §± / ^° / ² ↔︎ \| / <>, depending on the layout) could produce the wrong characters when CGEventTap fallback was enabled.
  • ⚡️ Improvements
    • Improved text and other UI elements for macOS 27.
    • Improved focused UI element detection in Google Chrome and Electron-based applications by handling delayed Accessibility initialization. (Thanks to @duanyutong)
    • Added markers for enabled rules in the Complex Modifications assets list. (Thanks to @dhffdh)
    • Improved same-timestamp event reordering for QMK/ZMK keyboards. Modifier releases in the same HID report are now processed before key presses, and events are reordered independently for each device. (Thanks to @Leandros)
    • Changed inter-process communication between Karabiner-Elements processes from UNIX domain sockets to XPC.
    • Fixed an issue where selection indicators in the Simple Modifications key picker were not displayed on macOS 27.
    • Added search to the Simple Modifications key picker.
    • EventViewer now displays caps lock LED state changes with an appropriate name instead of "Unsupported HID usage".
    • Add Show confirmation submenu for Quit Karabiner-Elements configuration.
    • JavaScript-based Complex Modifications rules are no longer evaluated while disabled.
    • Limited the maximum size of karabiner.json to 64 MB.
    • Limited JavaScript console.log output to 1 MB.
    • Improved internal handling of expressions used by set_variable to ensure consistent equality and hashing. (Thanks to @monsterlag)
    • Improved key repeat for mappings with modifiers so that the modifiers remain active while the key is repeating.
    • Improved to_if_alone handling so that actual remapped output cancels it, while keys disabled with vk_none do not.
    • Migrated the app icons to the Icon Composer format, and removed the app icon selection setting.
    • Added a "Capture macOS Key Events" to EventViewer.
    • Added a "Capture mouse wheels" option to EventViewer.
    • Supported the following keys:
      • generic_desktop::system_power_down
      • generic_desktop::system_wake_up

More

item.title: Version 14.13.0
item.description:
About v14.13.0 Update

  • 📅 Release date
    • Dec 9, 2023
  • 🔔 Important Notes
    • A reboot is required when upgrading from version 14.12.0 or earlier, to update the virtual keyboard driver.
  • ✨ New Features
    • Palm detection is supported in MultitouchExtension. (Thanks to @quarkw)
    • Use Bluetooth address (Bluetooth MAC address) is used to identify the device when the Bluetooth device does not have Vendor ID and Product ID. (Thanks to @stackia)
    • Add the following settings into Devices tab.
      • Flip mouse X
      • Flip mouse Y
      • Flip mouse vertical wheel
      • Flip mouse horizontal wheel
      • Swap mouse X and Y
      • Swap mouse wheels
    • Gamepad support (DirectInput devices are supported. Xinput is not supported at all)
    • Added “Add your own rule” button into Complex Modifications settings.
    • The json content of Complex Modifications can now be changed via the Edit button.
    • Added “Move item to top” and “Move item to bottom” into the context menu of the Complex Modifications list.
    • Add the following options to karabiner_cli
      • --format-json
      • --eval-js
      • --silent
    • Changes for users who write their own json.
      • The device_address condition has been added into device_if and device_unless. (Thanks to @stackia)
      • Added key_up_value to set_variable.
      • Added mouse_basic manipulator.
  • ⚡️ Improvements
    • Added the ability to filter by keywords when adding Complex Modifications rules.
    • Adjusted the position of the Add rule button in Complex Modifications. (Thanks to @GanZhiXiong)
    • MultitouchExtension has been rewritten in Swift.

item.title: Version 12.10.0
item.description:
About v12.10.0 Update

About Legacy System Extension alert

This release still uses the kernel extension (aka legacy system extension), so the following alert will be shown.

We are working to migrate to a newer mechanism, DriverKit, from kernel extension and we plan to support it at Karabiner-Elements 13.0.0. It will take a little more time. Please wait.

Changes

  • ✨ New Features
    • event_changed_if and event_changed_unless has been added to conditions.
  • ⚡️ Improvements
    • Improved sending f1-f12 keys in complex modification (e.g., “change command+e to f2”) by ignoring media key mappings for these keys.
    • Improved caps lock LED handling.
    • Improved uninstaller adding the kernel extension staging area clean up.
    • Improved complex modifications json checker.
    • “Check for updates” has been improved.
      • Updated Sparkle signing to EdDSA (ed25519) from DSA.
      • URL of appcast.xml has been updated.

More
